text: This application proposes to amend the former City of North York Zoning By-law 7625 and the new City-wide 569-2013 Zoning By-law at 1202 and 1204 Avenue Road to permit a seven unit, three-storey townhouse development at the north-west corner of Avenue Road and Hillhurst Boulevard. Access to seven rear parking spaces is proposed via a driveway entering and exiting from Hillhurst Boulevard. The proposed development is consistent with the Provincial Policy Statement (2014) and conforms with the Growth Plan for the Greater Golden Horseshoe (2017). This report reviews and recommends approval of the applications to amend the Official Plan and the Zoning By-law.
North York Community Council: 1. Adjourned its public meeting under the Planning Act until May 22, 2019, at 9:45 a.m.
